name: remotion-cards-kit
description: Props-driven title cards for long-form video: a verbatim disclosure card, a removable recap card and end card, and a cue-sheet timeline, built with Remotion.

scripts.render:episode: npm run guide && remotion render src/index.ts EpisodeTimeline out/episode-window-1080p.mp4 --props=data/episode.sample.json --frames=13400-13700
scripts.render:episode:feature-cut: npm run guide && remotion render src/index.ts EpisodeTimeline out/episode-window-feature-cut.mp4 --props=data/episode.feature-cut.json --frames=12920-13220
scripts.verify:sync: node scripts/verify-sync.mjs out/episode-window-1080p.mp4 13400 13440 192 && node scripts/verify-sync.mjs out/episode-window-feature-cut.mp4 12920 12960 192
scripts.stills: npm run still:disclosure && npm run still:recap
